recent_en: AIMAX Berhad's recent announcements mainly involve the provision of financial assistance, along with shareholder interest change filings. The company released its consolidated quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026 on 27 August 2026.
notable_en: The company released its consolidated quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026 on 27 August 2026.
The company announced the provision of financial assistance on 27 August, 2 September and 9 October 2026.
